email_body:
Hello RoadTek team,

I am applying for the Project Coordinator role in Winton advertised on SEEK and SmartJobs (QLD/703863/26).

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project in charge, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day, and then as a field engineer tracking procurement and materials and preparing progress reports. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers on road works, with support for tendering and estimating, is the work I want to build on. My coordination experience is from the Philippines rather than Australian road crews, and I am open to discussing relocation to Winton.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for the Project Coordinator position with RoadTek in Winton, reference QLD/703863/26. The role plans and coordinates multi functional work crews on civil infrastructure, manages resources, subcontractors and suppliers, supports short term programming and helps the estimating team with tenders.

From April to September 2019 I was project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, finished within its six month program. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, passed on work priorities, tracked progress and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was a field engineer on subdivision finishing works, tracking procurement and materials, preparing progress reports and working with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers.

My coordination experience is from the Philippines rather than Australian road crews, and I do not hold a Certificate IV in Project Management. I hold an Australian driver licence, a White Card and my own transport, have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, am available for regional travel and am open to discussing relocation to Winton.
My resume is attached and drawings from my study are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.
